text:
anita: quick bring-up notes — ran llm-medium int8 across us-east/us-west/eu-west comparing direct egress vs edge proxy. p50 looks OK but p95 jumps on proxy paths, esp in eu-west. @mike @lia can you eyeball?

mike: dropping numbers?

anita: paste below (small sample CSV from the run)

```
region,path,p50_ms,p95_ms,throughput_rps
us-east,direct,28,52,185
us-east,edge-proxy,36,92,170
us-west,direct,30,57,180
us-west,edge-proxy,39,118,160
eu-west,direct,40,76,150
eu-west,edge-proxy,48,142,135
```

lia: wow that eu-west p95 delta is big — looks like queueing + longer proxy tail. did you see any connection churn or TLS renegotiation spikes?

anita: no obvious renegotiation in the logs. proxy shows a couple of 5xx but small. I did capture proxy latency histograms and kernel selection logs.

sam: could be kernel fallback on h100 int8 path? if runtime picks a generic kernel under certain request sizes, p95 could spike. kai, any idea?

kai: yup. saw this before — for certain seq_len distribution the optimized int8 kernel isn't chosen and falls back to slower path. that plus edge queuing = amplified p95. what hardware were these pinned to?

anita: tests on Dedicated h100 (us-east/us-west) and eu-west is mixed h100 + older a100 nodes. the eu-west mix likely explains worse tail.

mike: recommendation: split experiment into (1) direct-only across regions (control), (2) edge-proxy with same kernel pinning, (3) edge-proxy without kernel pinning. can we run each for 10k requests and collect p50/p95 and kernel-use logs?

anita: already queued a longer run. small helper curl to reproduce one-off sample: 

```
curl -s -X POST https://redwood-infer.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"llm-medium-int8","input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":64}' | jq .
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy of proxy-route v2 completed at 2024-11-02T18:12:03Z :white_check_mark:

lia: since deploy happened mid-run, toss runs that overlapped the deploy window. they will bias p95.

anita: good call — will filter. initial cleaned numbers still show ~40-60ms extra p95 on proxy vs direct in eu-west.

sam: also test with kv warmup enabled — cold kv misses can inflate p95. toggle param: enable_eager_kv_warmup = true.

kai: on h100 int8 we also have an alternate kernel that reduces p95 but lowers throughput slightly. consider model-variant pinning for latency-sensitive routes.

mike: put together a short matrix doc with axes: region, path(direct/proxy), kernel (opt/fallback), warmup(on/off). capture p50/p95/throughput and node mix. we'll use that for capacity sizing.

anita: will run the matrix overnight and paste results tomorrow AM. next immediate action: 1) re-run eu-west with homogeneous h100 pool 2) re-run proxy test with TLS passthrough disabled (to remove proxy CPU crypto overhead) 3) enable eager_kv_warmup for a sample batch.

lia: sounds good. if eu-west tail persists with homogeneous h100, we escalate to infra to look at network fabric.

mike: :thumbsup: thanks team. if anyone wants to jump on a quick room at 10:30 UTC to review metrics live, ping here.

anita: pinging results thread when done. thanks!
